_doc: A bottle of the game's own booze (#1222, docs/briefs/booze.md): a tall aqua patent-medicine panel bottle, a flat front for its label, a cork. Its labels the brands of its shape (Dr. Felder'S, Dr. Tolliver'S, Dr. Pellow'S, Dr. Pemberly'S, Dr. Windham'S, Dingle'S Berry, Dr. Boner'S): the Nth made wears label N mod 7 (`variants`), or the one its dressing entry names (`variant`; tools/props/booze.py variant_of). A prop that shatters (GlassProp): a fall onto boards at 3.6 m/s or 50 kPa breaks it and what's in it goes on the floor. Drawn from glb:booze_bottles (tools/blender/props/booze.py): the glass the kit's `glass:` look, every label printed on one sheet (pbr:booze_labels), cork and contents baked the gun way. Written by tools/props/booze.py.
